For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, P  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 22/03/2023 The instant misc. petition has been filed by the petitioner for quashing of FIR No.417/2022, Police Station Mahamandir, District Jodhpur for offences under Sections 420 & 406 of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor has submitted a report dated 20.03.2023 received from the SHO, Police Station Mahamandir, District Jodhpur east, wherein it has been mentioned that Police is going to submit a Final Report in this case.
The said report is hereby taken on record.
In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the present misc. petition has become infructuous and dismissed accordingly.

(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 137-raksha/-
